mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points indicates accelerating labor market weakness, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE rising > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1200 thousand units and industrial production below 105 (2017=100) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1200 and INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a 3-month increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points is a reliable indicator of economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production index above 105 (2017=100) consistently reflects robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector, which typically precedes broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high CPI (above 250 index) and low federal funds rate (below 2.5%) indicate a policy dilemma where inflation is rising but the central bank is not tightening, causing market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a 3-month increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points is a reliable leading indicator of economic deceleration, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
